text:
maria: Heads-up — sample-auth on API 23 emulator is triggering a token refresh storm. Network and CPU spike, many concurrent refresh calls.

sam: Are you using OkHttp Authenticator or an Interceptor refresh flow?

maria: Interceptor. We detect 401, do refresh, replay. But on the slow emulator many calls hit 401 simultaneously and each tries to refresh. Logs show repeated (retry) lines.

gloria: Yep, that's the coroutine + interceptor re-entrancy issue. OkHttp calls can re-enter the chain while a refresh is in flight.

maria: Example log:
I/OkHttp: --> GET /v1/generate
I/OkHttp: <-- 401 Unauthorized (3ms)
I/OkHttp: --> GET /v1/generate (retry)
I/OkHttp: <-- 401 Unauthorized (2ms)
I/OkHttp: --> GET /v1/generate (retry)

sam: Also note: Authenticator only runs when server sends WWW-Authenticate. Our backend omits it, so Authenticator won't help for bearer tokens. Interceptor is correct but needs a guard.

gloria: Recommended pattern: Mutex (kotlinx.coroutines) + tag retried requests with header like X-Authed-Retry to avoid loops. Use runBlocking inside interceptor to bridge.

maria: Any snippet? Sane timeout advice?

sam: Compact pattern: create a refreshMutex, in intercept do proceed, if 401 and no X-Authed-Retry then runBlocking{ if (!refreshMutex.isLocked) refreshMutex.withLock { authService.refreshSync() } } then replay request with Authorization updated and X-Authed-Retry:1. Also use a short callTimeout on the refresh client so lock isn't held long.

gloria: Also avoid relying on retryOnConnectionFailure(true) to hide TLS handshake errors — that caused duplicate refreshes for us. On <API24 emulators TLS can be flaky; recommend ProviderInstaller/Conscrypt or test on GMS images.

maria: I'll open a tiny PR adding GuardedAuthInterceptor, a unit test simulating concurrent 401s, a sample change, and a README note. Will gate a telemetry metric when >3 concurrent refresh attempts.

devex-bot: PR draft created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-android/pull/599 — includes GuardedAuthInterceptor, tests, sample change. CI: https://ci.redwood.ai/artifacts/599

sam: Nice. Add connectedAndroidTest on a reproducible API 23 image and assert flakes < 3% before merging.

maria: Yep, will run `./gradlew :samples:sample-auth:connectedAndroidTest` on clean image and post results. Thanks!
